title: The Vow of Maple Hollow
author: Petra Underhill
blurb: Kestrel Ashgrove, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, has spent ten years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
